nodes.value: Walterin Prague Sticker Set | Illustrated City Icons & Characters
A fun illustrated Prague sticker set with Walterin characters, city icons, and comic-style artwork. Ideal for notebooks, gifts, creatives, and Prague lovers.

– Two 210 × 210 mm sticker sheets (high-quality matte finish)
– Walterin original comic stickers from the Prague edition
– Durable adhesive (long-lasting, won’t peel easily)
– Crisp, vibrant colours with premium art-print quality
– Each sheet includes mini Prague stories hidden in the icons
– Designed for laptops, notebooks, journals, water bottles & gifts

🎨 Original artwork illustrated by the Walterin cartoonist
👕 Premium cotton comfort — soft, breathable, everyday wear
🏛️ Prague-inspired design featuring Café Slavia & Absinthe Drinker
